keyEvents.text: Substitution, Villarreal. Nicolas Pepe replaces Gerard Moreno because of an injury.
Rafel Bauzà (Espanyol) is shown the yellow card.
Roger Hinojo (Espanyol) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santi Comesaña (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Ayoze Pérez replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Substitution, Villarreal. Carlos Romero replaces Sergi Cardona.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Espanyol 1. Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Bryan Zaragoza with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Espanyol. José Ángel replaces Roger Hinojo.
Substitution, Espanyol. Pol Lozano replaces Rafel Bauzà.
Bryan Zaragoza (Espanyol) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Espanyol. Javi Puado replaces Bryan Zaragoza.
Substitution, Espanyol. Jan Peries replaces Alejandro Santiago.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alex Freeman replaces Pau Navarro.
Substitution, Villarreal. Tani Oluwaseyi replaces Tajon Buchanan.
Substitution, Espanyol. Gabriel Moscardo replaces Javi Hernández.
Carlos Maciá (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
